title: Station restart with a clock jump and a late backfill
description: S2 restarted at t=900 s; its clock jumped by 1500 s and its drift changed sign. S3 was offline and needs to upload records 20 minutes after the others. Arrival order and wall-clock elapsed time must not enter the association: only per-boot calibrated reference time counts, and a station without a complete progress report keeps its events provisional.

boots.reboot_reason: power cycle; supercapacitor-backed RTC lost 1500 s

expected.note: S2's two boots must have separate calibration models
